test_inputs: Discrete pin strapping inputs: ID7_DSP..ID0_DSP = 00111110; Parity valid; Asset Type = ATYPE_3; LRU = LRU_7.
expected_result: Software correctly decodes discrete pins to Asset_Type = ATYPE_3, Target LRU = LRU_7 (Rudder), Location_Invert = 0, SurfaceID = TYPE_3_LRU_7. Pin strapping verification successful.
test_procedure_notes: Verify via internal memory registers and STL_Bus telemetry.
